answer: Pay by network origin. Each epoch the mint buckets identities by /24 subnet and ASN: the first 3 in a bucket get full reward, and any extra keys split a fixed 3-share pot. If an operator called Sparrow runs 30 keys on one VPS, those 30 earn what 3 honest agents earn. Thresholds are published 7 days ahead and the buckets are posted on-chain. Hosted accounts bucket by the client origin the gateway logs. Spreading a farm across many ASNs becomes a costly voyage, and the cheap single-host farm becomes a relic.
